name: config-value-icons
goal: Config collections use distinct object and array icon controls with accurate counts and expandable read-only contents.

evidence: Replace config source snippets and View value text with distinct object and array icon controls. Show static attribute/item counts, expandable nested contents, and exact source without executing config code.

Existing category-folder browser matrix only asserts compact row height and source modal text; fixtures lack arrays and nested objects. Extend that matrix plus the existing committed-config parser cases to cover structural counts, nested expansion, empty/spread values, source retention, and focus at all viewports.
